title: FormControl
description: Field container that links a label, a control, help text and an error message, and shares invalid / required / disabled / read-only state with the control.

props.name: id
props.description: Used to reference react managed views from native code.

support.notes: With Form / useForm: validation on the core field machine

api.notes: With Form / useForm: validation on the core field machine

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the field in the Form values (required inside a Form)

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the field

props.name: helperText
props.description: Help text below the control (hidden while the field is invalid)

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error message; makes the field invalid unless `invalid` is set

props.name: invalid
props.description: Forces the invalid state on / off (unset: invalid while a rule fails or `errorMessage` is set)

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field as required (indicator on the label, "required" for screen readers) and adds the `required` rule

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the control (also set by a disabled Form)

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Makes the control read-only (also set by a read-only Form)

props.name: rules
props.description: Validation rules

props.name: validateOn
props.description: First validation on every change, on blur or only on submit (then every change re-validates)

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value

props.name: valuePropName
props.description: Prop of the control holding the value

props.name: trigger
props.description: Change callback of the control (first argument = new value)

translationResources.title: FormControl
translationResources.description: Field container that links a label, a control, help text and an error message, and shares invalid / required / disabled / read-only state with the control.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: FormLabel targets the control, the helper text describes it, and the error message replaces the helper while invalid.

form-field.title: FormField
form-field.description: FormField combines FormControl, FormLabel, helper text and error message; errorMessage makes the field invalid.

states.title: States
states.description: required adds an indicator and aria-required; disabled and readOnly reach the control.

custom-control.title: Custom control
custom-control.description: useFormControlProps wires any control (id, aria attributes, disabled, readOnly); useFormControlContext reads the field state.

FormControlProps.invalid: Marks the field as invalid: the control gets aria-invalid and the error message replaces the helper text
FormControlProps.required: Marks the field as required (aria-required on the control, indicator on the label)
FormControlProps.disabled: Disables the control inside the field
FormControlProps.readOnly: Makes the control inside the field read-only
FormControlProps.id: Id of the control; the label, helper and error ids derive from it (`${id}-label`, `${id}-helper`, `${id}-error`). Generated when omitted
FormControlProps.children: Field content: FormLabel, a control, FormHelperText, FormErrorMessage

FormLabelProps.requiredIndicator: Indicator shown after the text when the field is required (hidden from assistive technology, which gets aria-required instead)

FormFieldProps.label: Label of the field
FormFieldProps.helperText: Help text below the control (hidden while the field is invalid)
FormFieldProps.errorMessage: Error message; makes the field invalid unless `invalid` is set explicitly

cssVars.--form-control-gap: Space between the label, the field and the helper / error text
cssVars.--form-control-helper-font-size: Font size of the helper and error texts

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Wraps one control, Minerva or native: the label names it, the helper text describes it and required adds the indicator. Clicking the label focuses the control or toggles a switch.

states.title: States
states.description: invalid swaps the helper text for the error message and marks the control; readonly, disabled and required are forwarded to the control, and required-indicator changes the marker.

slots.title: Rich content slots
slots.description: The label, helper-text and error-message slots accept markup instead of the plain-text attributes.

form.title: In a form
form.description: With novalidate, the submit handler checks each control's checkValidity() and shows the field's own error message (invalid) instead of the browser bubbles; editing clears it and reset clears everything.

props.readOnly: Makes the slotted control read-only (readonly / readOnly and aria-readonly).

slots.default: The control: one Minerva form control or native <input> / <select> / <textarea>.
slots.label: Rich label content (alternative to the label attribute).
